final: WITH g AS (SELECT MediaTypeId AS mid, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS overall FROM g WHERE avg_price IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.mid, g.avg_price, g.avg_price * 1.0 / o.overall AS ratio FROM g JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
